scope: local payment-disconnected abandoned-lock inspection and recovery
claims: lock owners use a ledger-bound v2 record with pid, creation instant and random nonce
inspection validates the complete owner record and returns a SHA-256 fingerprint without mutation
recovery requires the exact inspected fingerprint and atomically writes an exclusive claim inside the canonical lock directory before deletion
a crashed recoverer leaves the canonical lock and claim present so ledger mutation remains blocked
malformed, missing, replaced or drifted ownership fails closed
limitations: an operator must independently establish abandonment before recovery
this is a single-host file boundary, not a distributed transaction protocol
